text: A program manager is in the program definition phase and is working on one of the program documents. He is including details regarding program outcomes, cost benefit analysis, alternative solutions, financial analysis, and market demands. In which program artifact is he working?
Which of the following is an individual or a group responsible for providing resources and support for the program and is accountable for enabling success?

Kate is a program manager of her organization and is working with her program team to create the program scope. Based on the program requirements, she has identified the major deliverables of each phase in her program scope. Management has asked her that she plans for cost estimating for each phase of the program before continuing the work. Management may elect to cancel the program at the end of each phase based on the past performance of the program. What is the review of management called at each phase?
Which of the following are considered as the outputs of the program schedule monitoring and controlling activity?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Updates to the program master schedule
B. Updates to the change requests
C. Updates to the program roadmap
D. Updates to the risk register

text: Which of the following dimensions should an organization consider during the feasibility study process to decide on the proposed program?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
What is the key tool that helps the stakeholders to assess the overall health of the program and take appropriate action to ensure successful benefits delivery?
choices: A. Understanding how the program objectives translate into program benefits
B. Developing meaningful metrics and KPIs
C. Identifying and quantifying business benefits
D. Consistent monitoring and reporting on benefits metrics

text: Jack is a program manager for his organization. He is working on the ABC program and has reached to his program financial closure phase. choices: A. Input to the program final report
C. Inputs into the knowledge repository
D. Updates to the program financial management plan

text: As a program manager, Sally had a long-term experience in the local government where she has managed and executed multiple programs. Today, she has been assigned a new development program called Delta-A. When developing a program governance plan for Delta-A, what should Sally do with her existing program governance plan that she developed and matured it during her last program?
choices: A. She should apply the changes related to the Delta-A program requirements such as its business needs, political, competitive environments, etc. to the existing program governance plan before using it.
B. She should use the old existing program governance plan as it is.
C. She should adopt the existing matured program governance plan before using it.
D. She should neglect the old governance plan.

text: What is the primary goal of conducting program-level procurement?
choices: A. To set standards for the components such as blanket purchase agreements, formalized proposal evaluation criteria
B. To identify impacts to the program components from overruns or underruns
C. To monitor contract expenditures to ensure funds are disbursed in accordance with the contracts
D. To ensure that quality plans are implemented at project and subsidiary program levels

text: As part of the program procurement management planning activity, which of the following will help in determining the best fit of solutions and services to meet the specific needs of the program?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

Ryan is the program manager of XYZ Inc. Holly, the project sponsor, has asked him to perform an analysis for the program that specifies the program objectives and identifies the internal and external factors that are favorable and unfavorable for achieving those objectives. Which analysis will Ryan perform?
You are the program manager of the XYZ program. During the midway of the program, a stakeholder has requested a scope change, which would affect the program cost and schedule. What will you do first?
choices: A. Reassign work to the team.
B. Record in the program change log.

text: What are the governance-related responsibilities of a program manager?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Facilitating the sharing of resources, methodologies, tools, and techniques
B. Overseeing program conformance to governance policies and processes
C. Managing program interactions with the steering committee and sponsor
D. Monitoring and reporting on overall program funding and health

text: Ryan is working on a highly complex program. He needs to develop an artifact, which describes major program events for planning and the development of more detailed schedules. Which artifact will Ryan develop?

Which of the following documents provides the program manager with the authority to apply organizational resources to program activities and connects the program to the organization's ongoing work and strategic priorities?
According to the Standard of Program Management, which of the following are Program Management Performance Domains?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

You are a senior program manager of your organization. You are currently in the middle of executing a strategic program, called UC-program, of your organization. During the benefit realization process of a subprogram of UC-program, you find that it is very technical for you to decide whether a specific deliverable delivered was as planned or not. What should you do?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Set up a meeting with the technical team to get a detailed explanation regarding the planned and achieved results of the deliverable.
B. Ignore the issue as the technical architect is responsible for the subprogram.
C. Initiate a program health check to verify the specific deliverable delivered.
D. Initiate a program review to verify the specific deliverable.

text: Which of the following best describe the role of a program manager in benefits management?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Analyzes the potential impact of planned program changes on the expected benefits and outcomes
B. Identifies and assesses the value and impact of program benefits
C. Determines the overall health of the program and takes appropriate action for ensuring successful benefits delivery
D. Aligns the expected benefits with the organization's goals and objectives

text: Which of the following is a document that officially recognizes and acknowledges that a program exists?

Ana is a project manager working on the hexacore processor development program in a mobile company. Her project has not yet started, but her program manager wants her to start the project, as the program is lagging behind the expected timeline. But before she can receive the go-ahead to initiate the project, it is necessary to:
choices: A. Communicate with the key stakeholders to understand their requirements.
B. Define the expected benefits in the business case.
D. Assign work to the team members.

text: The benefits transition phase ensures which of the following?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. The program benefits are measured.
B. The sustainment plans are developed.
C. The program requirements are approved.
D. The scope of the transition is defined.

text: Ryan is working for an international training organization. His organization has decided to add several new lines of courses. Ryan will be the program manager for these new courses. He plans to have a team of people from international organizations located in different countries to support him as he needs to translate each course into at least four other languages and pilot test them in other parts of the world. After this program is initiated, he then will work to authorize the various projects within it. Furthermore, it is important to have a high-level plan for the program's components. This plan is stated in which of the following documents?

A program life cycle consists of program definition, program delivery, and program closure phases. To support these phases, a list of program activities is performed to accomplish its successful delivery. The closure phase is one of the important phases of the program and is not part of which of the following supporting program activities?

John is a program manager who is currently executing one activity in which he is periodically evaluating overall program quality to provide confidence that the program will comply with the relevant quality policies and standards. Which activity is John executing?
choices: A. Program quality assurance and control

text: Andrew is appointed as a program manager in XYZ Inc. He is assigned a task of an internal restructuring of his organization, which has not been reorganized from last 10 years. Many new programs and projects are underway. Also, he has to perform a detailed analysis of some of the existing programs, which do not seem to relate to the new five-year strategic plan the organization issued six months ago to check if they are feasible till now. He has to complete this reconstructing in six months. As Andrew initiates this program, which of the following is important?
choices: A. Defining the program-related governance processes
B. Establishing the benefits management plan

text: John is a program manager in XYZ Inc. He has been assigned a program that contains four projects. Initially, risk identification and risks analysis have been performed for all the projects and contingency reserves have been established at the project and program levels. How frequently should the program manager review the project level risk during the program?
choices: A. According to scheduled risk reviews
B. As requested by the stakeholder
C. As specified in the project schedule
D. As requested by the project manager

text: Which of the following statements are true of stakeholder engagement?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. It is performed by people with different roles in the program and project teams.
B. It is a continuous activity in a program.
C. It is expressed only as direct communication among the stakeholder and the program's leaders and team.
D. It gains and maintains stakeholder buy-in for the program's objectives, benefits, and outcomes.

text: The outputs of the program change monitoring and controlling activity include which of the following?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Updates to the program change log
D. Inputs to program management plan changes

text: Following the approval of which document, the program steering committee authorizes the program using the program charter document?

Katy, a program manager, needs to analyze component interdependencies for determining the best approach for managing program components. Which of the following actions will Katy perform?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Ensure that the outputs and outcomes of a program's components are effectively communicated.
B. Align program efforts with the organizational strategy and the program's business case.
C. Monitor benefits realization of program components to make sure they remain strategically aligned to the organization's goals.
D. Ensure that the organization accepts the right projects and allocates critical resources appropriately.

text: As a program manager, you will use which of the following analyses to examine the component project for its weakness and opportunities to identify both negative and positive risks?

Andrew has started managing a program. He is developing a business register on the basis of the program business case, the organization's strategic plan, and other relevant program objectives. In which program benefits management phase is Andrew working?

John is a program manager of his company, where he is developing a program for the next-generation automobiles. His company is working diligently to be the first to market with these new automobiles as they are using advanced technology, and it differs significantly from that of the competition. The company uses program oversight committees to oversee all programs for the overall governance. In this program governance framework, who is responsible for monitoring and tracking the overall program benefits realization?

A program manager can perform which of the following forms of analysis for assessing the validity of a program's business case and program management plan?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
You are working on a program that includes five projects, each managed by a project manager. Who should be responsible for the identification of risks on the program? (Select the best answer.)
choices: A. All the stakeholders of the program
C. The program managers and the project managers

text: Which of the following activities establishes both the management and technical resources of the program and its components and refers to both personnel and to program-specific tools, facilities, and finances for managing the program?
choices: D. Program performance monitoring and controlling

text: John has started working on a program whose budget is specified. He has a doubt that the program investment may exceed the specified budget. He needs to take care of the predetermined budget of the program so that the program scope will not get affected. Which of the following factors should John consider?
Which plan should involve an approval or authorization process for allocating funds for the program components?
Kate is about to start the transition phase of her S-MAX program. Why should she consult the program steering committee?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. To determine whether the program has achieved all the required benefits
B. To determine whether all transition work has been performed within the component transition
C. To determine whether there is another program or sustaining activity that will oversee the ongoing benefits for which this program was chartered
D. To determine whether the program has completed the business case review

text: A cooling technology project is part of a major program in the ABC company. This project has identified two dependent risks, which have occurred now and will cost an additional cost of $1 million. How should these risks be handled in the program?
choices: A. From the contingency reserves of the project
B. From the contingency reserves of the program
C. From the management reserves of the project
D. From the management reserves of the program

text: You are helping John, a new program manager in your organization. He is currently preparing the program cost estimates for his new, assigned program. He wants to know how the program's cost is attributed. What will you reply to John?
choices: A. The majority of the program's cost is attributable to only managing the program itself.
B. The majority of the program's cost is attributable to managing the program itself and not to the individual components within the program.
C. The majority of the program's cost is attributable to the individual components within the program and not to managing the program itself.
D. The majority of the program's cost is attributable to both the individual components within the program and to managing the program itself.

text: The program delivery management activity contains which of the following for delivering the capabilities and benefits needed for the organization to realize value?
choices: A. Program performance reports and forecasts of the program components
B. Management, oversight, integration, and optimization of the program components
C. Financial management systems and earned value management activities of the program components
D. Documents, data, and knowledge repositories of the program components

text: Two program managers, Shelly and Jack are discussing the difference between program management and program governance. Shelly says program governance includes the framework, functions, and processes by which a program is monitored, managed, and supported for meeting the organizational strategic and operational goals and program management is the application of knowledge, skills, tools, and techniques. However, Jack says program governance is one of the performance domains that is all about managing program activities required for facilitating effective program definition, program delivery, and program closure and program management is an ongoing function in an organization that performs activities that produce products or services. Which of the following will be the correct answer?
choices: A. Shelly is describing it correctly.
B. Jack is describing it correctly.
C. Both Shelly and Jack are describing it correctly.
D. Both Shelly and Jack are describing it wrong.

text: Jack, as a program manager, is in the process of gathering, creating, storing, distributing, and disposing of program information. Which program activity is he working on?
choices: A. Program quality assurance and control
D. Program schedule monitoring and controlling

text: You are working on the Y-TEL program that has recently received approval for transition and closure. However, you receive a change request from one of the stakeholders, which would affect the program cost and schedule. What should the program manager do?
choices: A. Reassign the work to the team members.
B. Update the program management plan and program scope statement.
C. Inform the stakeholder that the program is closing down and no changes can be accommodated.
D. Assess the impact of the change on the program's outcomes and benefits and then take a decision.

text: A program manager is performing the program scope management planning activity throughout the course of her program. Which of the following are considered the outputs of this activity?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

choices: B. Program information archiving and transition

text: Which domain clarifies the vision of the organization, facilitates alignment of the program with organizational strategy, and enables the periodic balancing of program demands with current organizational capabilities?

choices: A. Key performance indicators are identified.
B. The benefits register is developed.
D. The benefits register is updated.

text: How does the consideration of enterprise environmental factors help?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

B. It helps in the evolution of an organization.

D. It helps in the ongoing assessment.

text: Which program management performance domain helps the program team in determining if benefits achievement is occurring within the stated parameters so changes to the components or the program is proposed when necessary?

choices: A. Whether the changes are requested by an individual stakeholder or multiple stakeholders

text: The program manager should include which of the following when developing the program financial management plan?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
Which of the following domains manages the activities of the program required for facilitating effective program definition, program delivery, and program closure?

As a program manager, how will you help stakeholders in establishing common high-level expectations for the delivery of the program's benefits?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

text: John is a program manager of his newly assigned program. His new program requires identification of all the stakeholders that will be affected by the program's outcome. Where should the identified stakeholders and their information be documented?
The program master schedule document includes which of the following activities that are unique to the program?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Activities related to stakeholder engagement
B. Activities related to program-level governance
C. Activities related to program-level reviews
D. Activities related to program-level risk mitigation

text: John is managing a new program. He has three projects in this program during the first year. Following the standard benefits management life cycle, John develops this process during which phase?

choices: A. Maximum level of risk exposure for a risk to be included in the risk register

text: You are a program manager of the X-MAX program of your organization. Which of the following are components of a program risk register that are updated as part of the program risk response management activity?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

text: As a program manager, Sam has just finished one of the activities where he got the program risk register created. Which activity was Sam executing?

Fenny is a program manager for the development of a new hi-tech ice cooler program. This cooler will work on the coolant technology and seems to be practically successful. Hence, she asks one of her team members to prepare a document so that each stakeholder receives appropriate information they need in a useful format and in a timely manner. Which of the following will be the required document?

Cheri is working on a program, which is in its benefits transition phase. She needs to ensure that the results or outputs of the individual program component meet acceptance criteria. text: Stella is working as a program manager in an organization. During the organization's strategic planning, she needs to define organizational goals and activities. Which of the following should be identified and documented for this purpose?

Edward is in the execution of the benefits delivery phase. He knows that the resulting benefits review requires analysis of the planned versus actual benefits across a wide range of factors. Which of the following are the most important aspects to be analyzed in this scenario? Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

A program manager is performing the program scope monitoring and controlling activity. Which of the following are part of this activity? Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: B. Updates to the program management plan

text: Which of the following is/are the output of the program procurement management activity?

text: Ria is working on a program, which will create new software and install new hardware for her organization. She realized that there is a requirement to integrate the program components' deliverables, outcomes, and benefits into the program's end product, services, or results, such that the program delivers its intended benefits. Which phase contains activities that are executed as the result of an organization's plan for accomplishing strategic objectives or achieving the desired state within an organization's portfolio?

text: Which of the following describes the role of a program manager in benefits management?

text: The outputs of the program procurement management activity includes which of the following?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
